rules._note: Nov 22 2026 backtest vs closing lines 2013-25: 67 candidate rules (moneyline, total, run line at its real closing price) and 5 groups of new variables (wind by park, bullpen fatigue, umpire zone, lineup vs usual, travel/rest): none proven. The model picks winners 57.9% vs the closing line's 58.1%; its moneyline and run-line edges lose about the vig. Three leans only. total_offset: the model total is a mean, a betting total is a median.
